title: Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2609.38024v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An agent skill is a reusable, actionable natural-language artifact that guides an agent to perform a task effectively under a given harness. Recent studies have explored the optimization of agent skills, contributing to a growing collection of publicly available skills spanning diverse tasks, domains, and harnesses. Despite millions of publicly shared skills, existing skill optimization methods largely overlook this accumulated knowledge, instead relying solely on expensive agent rollouts to iteratively refine skills for a target task. To address this, we propose \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization (RASO)}, a framework that leverages an external skill corpus as prior knowledge throughout skill optimization. RASO retrieves relevant knowledge from existing skills and adapts it to the target task and harness via Cross-Harness Adaptation, accounting for mismatches in both domain and harness. RASO comprises two complementary stages

translated_title: 基于跨运行框架适配的检索增强技能优化
translated_abstract: 智能体技能是一种可复用、可执行的自然语言产物，用于指导智能体在给定运行框架下有效地执行任务。近期的研究探索了智能体技能的优化，促成了一个不断增长的公开可用技能集合，涵盖多样的任务、领域和运行框架。尽管已有数百万个公开共享的技能，现有的技能优化方法大多忽视了这些积累的知识，而是仅依赖代价高昂的智能体推演来迭代地为目标任务改进技能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了检索增强技能优化（Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization, RASO），这是一个在整个技能优化过程中利用外部技能语料库作为先验知识的框架。RASO 从现有技能中检索相关知识，并通过跨运行框架适配将其适配到目标任务与运行框架上，同时兼顾领域与运行框架两个层面的不匹配问题。RASO 包含两个互补的阶段（摘要内容在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出 RASO 框架，首次在智能体技能优化中利用海量公开技能语料库作为先验知识，通过检索相关技能并进行跨任务、跨运行框架的适配，避免了仅靠昂贵智能体推演来改进技能的传统做法。
en_tdlr: RASO introduces retrieval-augmented skill optimization that leverages millions of publicly shared agent skills as prior knowledge, using Cross-Harness Adaptation to transfer relevant skills to a target task and harness, thereby avoiding costly reliance on agent rollouts.
